how.text: Same squad and same states in all three: Teemo and Heimerdinger working, Jhin waiting on you, Braum finished, Caitlyn idle, the rest not summoned. Click a champion to select it. Every motion here is one Herdr can draw natively: spin, pulse, bob, slide, a growing bar.
